themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are translating polling momentum into major governance milestones and aggressive political demands. From state election polling surges in Germany to party-record longevity celebrations in Italy and ministerial demands in Sweden, nationalist forces are solidifying their positions within state and federal power structures.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements in North America and Europe are intensifying policy proposals targeting foreign nationals and religious expression. Coverage focuses on mass deportation operations, local bans on religious infrastructure and attire, and heightened security enforcement framed as essential for national preservation.

themes.title: Economic Nationalism and Trade Disputes
themes.blurb: Populist and nationalist administrations are using state policy to challenge foreign corporate exploitation and protect domestic resources. Rhetoric centers on trade surplus penalties, unilateral natural resource assertion, and dismantling environmental mandates perceived as crippling national industry.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders are actively reshaping public landmarks, state iconography, and institutional structures to cement their political legacy. From commemorative currency and national arch monuments to symbolic military installations, leaders leverage state power to project national pride.

themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties and administrations across borders are escalating attacks against legacy media outlets, public broadcasters, and cultural institutions. Common strategies include threatening tax exemptions, defunding public networks, and contesting intellectual property rules in AI technologies.
